title: Saints trade LB Deion Jones to 49ers for RB Zamir White: Sources
content:
The New Orleans Saints are trading linebacker Deion Jones to the San Francisco 49ers for running back Zamir White, team and league sources confirmed to The Athletic. The sources spoke anonymously because they were not yet authorized to speak publicly.

With Alvin Kamara out at least a month with a knee injury, the Saints were looking for running back depth, and one of the 49ers’ backup linebackers, Nick Martin, injured his hamstring in Thursday’s preseason game. Martin has been backing up Dre Greenlaw, who has been beset by injuries the past two seasons, at weakside linebacker. Two other linebackers — Luke Gifford (hamstring) and Jalen Graham (undisclosed) — also have missed recent practices.

Jones, 31, spent five seasons in Atlanta with 49ers defensive coordinator Raheem Morris.

The 49ers’ recently precarious running back situation, meanwhile, has looked better in recent days, as Kaelon Black, Jordan James and, on Sunday, Christian McCaffrey returned to practice. Those three are likely to be the only tailbacks on the 53-man roster to start the season. Another, Isaac Guerendo, is coming back from a torn pectoral muscle suffered in April.

Jones played in 17 games last season with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers and tallied 29 tackles. He has had brief stints with the Cleveland Browns and Carolina Panthers. Jones had his most productive run with the Atlanta Falcons, who selected him out of LSU in the second round of the 2016 NFL Draft. He played six seasons in Atlanta and was a Pro Bowler in 2017.

White was in his first year with the 49ers after spending the previous four seasons with the Las Vegas Raiders, who selected him in the fourth round of the 2022 draft.
